lines.beaver: 와, 공연 진짜 대단했지? 완전 감동이야.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, the show was amazing, right? I'm so moved.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, gongyeon jinjja daedanhaetji? Wanjeon gamdongiya.
lines.en: Yeah, I got goosebumps in the last scene.

lines.beaver_en: Me too! The actors were great, too.
lines.en: The lead's song was really thrilling.

lines.beaver_en: You cried in that scene, didn't you?
lines.en: Yeah, it touched my heart and I sobbed.

lines.beaver_en: So how did you feel then?
lines.en: I choked up and was deeply moved.

lines.beaver_en: They say it's based on a true story.
lines.en: Maybe it hit harder because it's true.
So annoying. Even I got irritated.

lines.beaver_en: The child actor acted well, too.
lines.en: So young but admirable. I was amazed.

lines.beaver: 두 번째 춤 장면은 흥이 넘쳤지?
lines.beaver_en: The second dance scene was so fun, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Du beonjjae chum jangmyeoneun heungi neomchyeotji?
lines.en: Yeah, I was so excited my shoulders were bouncing.

lines.learner: 전혀! 희로애락이 다 있어서 안 질렸어.
lines.en: Not at all! It had every emotion, so never boring.
lines.roman: Jeonhyeo! Huiroaeragi da isseoseo an jillyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Now that it's over, I feel a bit empty.
lines.learner: 좀 아쉽지만 같이 봐서 좋았어. 또 오자!
lines.en: It's a bit of a shame, but I loved seeing it with you. Let's come again!
lines.roman: Jom aswipjiman gachi bwaseo joasseo. Tto oja!
